2607.12188.title: Cost-Governed RAG: Unified Per-Tenant Cost Attribution Across Retrieval and Generation in Multi-Tenant LLM Systems
2607.12188.paper_summary: Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) deployments face a critical governance gap: while LLM generation cost is metered per token, the retrieval layer - vector memory, similarity compute, and embedding API calls - remains an unattributed shared cost, enabling invisible cross-subsidization among tenants. We present Cost-Governed RAG, an architecture that integrates a codebook-oblivious vector index (TurboVec) with a multi-tenant LLM governance gateway, creating a unified observability stack where embedding, retrieval, and generation costs are jointly attributable per tenant. The architecture exploits TurboVec's deterministic, closed-form memory formula to enable near-exact per-tenant retrieval cost calculation - a property unavailable in graph-based indexes with non-linear memory overhead. Deployed on Snowpark Container Services within a cloud data platform's governance boundary, the system achieves 99.96% end-to-end cost attribution accuracy across 100 simulated tenants (10M vectors, log-normal size distribution) with telemetry overhead below 0.04% of query latency. The architecture reduces retrieval infrastructure cost by 3.1-9.0x compared to managed vector database services under the pricing assumptions detailed in Section IV. We formalize a three-layer cost model and demonstrate that codebook-oblivious quantization enables deterministic per-tenant cost attribution while also removing the shared-codebook leakage surface present in trained quantizers - the latter observation being exploratory and subject to the limitations described in Section VII.
2607.12188.paper_summary_zh: 企業檢索增強生成（RAG）部署面臨一個關鍵的治理缺口：雖然大型語言模型（LLM）的生成成本是按每個標記計算的，但檢索層 - 向量記憶、相似度計算和嵌入API調用 - 仍然是一個未標明的共享成本，這使得租戶之間的隱性交叉補貼成為可能。我們提出了成本治理RAG，一種架構，將不依賴於代碼本的向量索引（TurboVec）與多租戶LLM治理網關集成，創建了一個統一的可觀察性堆棧，在這裡嵌入、檢索和生成成本可以按租戶共同歸因。該架構利用TurboVec的確定性閉合形式記憶公式，使得每個租戶的檢索成本計算幾乎精確 - 這一特性在具有非線性記憶開銷的圖形索引中是不可用的。該系統在雲數據平台的治理邊界內的Snowpark容器服務上部署，實現了對100個模擬租戶（1000萬個向量，對數正態大小分佈）的99.96%端到端成本歸因準確率，並且遙測開銷低於查詢延遲的0.04%。與第IV節中詳細說明的定價假設相比，該架構將檢索基礎設施成本降低了3.1-9.0倍。我們正式化了一個三層成本模型，並展示了不依賴於代碼本的量化使得確定性的每租戶成本歸因成為可能，同時也消除了訓練量化器中存在的共享代碼本泄漏面 - 後者的觀察是探索性的，並受到第VII節中描述的限制的約束。
2607.12188.author: Navnit Shukla et.al.
